cr_data.provenance: (The Intimate Gallery, New York, NY); Dorothy Norman, New York, NY, 1928/29; Mary Childs Draper, New York, NY, 1940s; Private collection, New York, NY, before 1977; (Kennedy Galleries, Inc., New York, NY); Private collection, Villanova, Pennsylvania, 1977; (Bill Dean, New York, NY); ACA Galleries, New York, NY, 1981; (Helene Wasserman Fine Art, New York, NY) (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Sold to Dorothy Norman." Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks, verso inscription date 1927. Backing inscription dates 1928. Dated 1927 on basis of verso inscription and inclusion in 1928 exhibition. See Appendix II, nos. 90, 91. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks.
titles.title: White Petunia with Salvia No. II

description: A large white petunia blooms on the righthand side of the canvas. Extending from behind it are a green leaf and the bright red flowers of a salvia plant.  These objects are set against a plain, grayish blue background.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
title: White Petunia with Salvia No. II
